registered_before: any work on D14-D18 and before any computation of D1-D12
source: owner 19/11: read the whole of research_notes/ (22 notes) and reports/ (7 reports); every takeaway was read and the ones that still apply to the token model are added; D13 already measured (io_uring_setup EPERM in a RuntimeDefault production pod, io_uring_disabled = 0: the path is closed by seccomp and seen by the seccomp hook)

D14_smoothing.source: research_notes/ML Pulse tới trần LID DS/score_design_rare_events.md (Witten-Bell is not the strongest smoothing; Kneser-Ney, hierarchical Pitman-Yor)
D14_smoothing.what: interpolated Kneser-Ney (absolute discount, continuation counts) in place of Witten-Bell, same tokens, grams, top-k and threshold rule
D14_smoothing.criterion: as D4: LID-DS 2021 development >= 529/544 with <= 6 false alarms, CB-DS >= 891 with <= 3, and more 2019 development detections than lidds-ml-v5-t3, or the same detections with fewer false alarms

D15_cusum.source: research_notes/ML Pulse tới trần LID DS/tail_and_recording_calibration.md Q3, fusion_small_data_short_recordings.md (Shewhart-CUSUM in log-evidence units, threshold on the per-recording maximum of the statistic)
D15_cusum.what: a Shewhart-CUSUM over window scores (one extreme window still fires; weak windows accumulate), threshold from held-out normal maxima of the statistic
D15_cusum.criterion: as D14, and p95 not worse by more than 0.5 s on LID-DS 2021 development

D16_pooled_tail.source: tail_and_recording_calibration.md Q6-Q7 (GEV with a pooled shape, censoring of the top 1-3 maxima)
D16_pooled_tail.what: threshold from a GEV whose shape is pooled across workloads/scenarios, location and scale per workload, top maxima censored

D17_process_context.source: score_design_rare_events.md (process name and return value in the token have measured gains), behaviour_features.md (per-executable profiles, startup phase by position since exec)
D17_process_context.what: offline on LID-DS 2021 development: n-gram history reset at execve and the executable name as a context token
D17_process_context.criterion: as D14; a probe change follows only if it passes

D18_attack_breadth.source: research_notes/Giới hạn và hướng phát triển/realistic_evaluation.md (Falco event-generator, Atomic Red Team container tests: behaviour simulators, not CVE exploits)
D18_attack_breadth.what: more attack behaviours for the final live campaign, through the same kubectl exec path, no vulnerable image, no exploit code
D18_attack_breadth.criterion: only with the owner's agreement (15/11 and 16/11 limits); reported in the final run
